message: “Happy anniversary! A decade, or two, or five — doesn’t really matter. What matters is that you’re still choosing each other on an ordinary Tuesday, still laughing at the same old jokes, still holding hands in the car without thinking about it. That’s the whole point. Here’s to more of it.”

“Happy birthday! A big number on the cake, sure, but the number never quite matches how you feel, and it definitely doesn’t match who you’ve become. You’ve earned every year you’re carrying. Today is for celebrating exactly that. The number is just the headline.”

“Happy birthday to the kid who turned my life completely upside down and somehow made it better. You’ve been teaching me more than I’ve been teaching you since about week two. Keep being exactly who you are. The world’s lucky to have you. So am I.”
